stage.note: Alibaba Group is a publicly listed multinational conglomerate (IPO 2014, NYSE + HKEX). Alibaba Cloud / Cloud Intelligence Group is an internal reporting segment, not a separately funded entity; ECS (Elastic Compute Service) is one of its products.

last_round.quote: In July 2015, the Alibaba Group invested US$1 billion in Alibaba Cloud.

revenue.kind: annualized revenue (Cloud Intelligence Group segment, run-rate from latest quarter)
revenue.basis: Alibaba Group's quarterly SEC/HKEX-filed results for Cloud Intelligence Group segment; annualized = 4x the reported quarterly figure of US$4,662 million
revenue.quote: Revenue from Cloud Intelligence Group was RMB33,398 million (US$4,662 million) in the quarter ended June 30, 2025, an increase of 26% compared to RMB26,549 million in the same quarter of 2024.

note: Alibaba Cloud (which sells the ECS product priced in the card) is not an independent company: it is the Cloud Intelligence Group operating segment of publicly traded Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE: BABA, HKEX: 9988). It has no separate startup-style funding history; the parent invested US$1B into the cloud unit in 2015 to build out infrastructure. Segment revenue is growing fast (+26% YoY in the June 2025 quarter, driven by AI/GenAI demand) but is reported only as part of Alibaba Group's consolidated financials, so 'total funding raised' as a startup metric does not apply — buyers should treat this as a hyperscaler-backed offering with full corporate financial backing rather than judge it on typical startup funding/runway terms.
